subject: [pool] q10ji built (q10jh + 0314 adaptive vcodec wait + 0315 RWJD_JOB JPEG-decoder path), sha a1098364, spare 2048
body: Image gpu/build/device-mmu-q10ji-candidate/ui-sched/nord2-ios-metal-q10ji-ui654fb60dvfs-cap3500-ram3776-sched.img sha256 a1098364ad520e02f17b75a9462a07295b80a59b7b90e3f600c199399d734576, FAILURES none, boot spare 2048 (next patch must cut strings). 0314: WAIT_IRQ/POLL spin 20 us for kern.n2vc.spin_us=2000 then msleep kern.n2vc.sleep_us=200 (was flat 500 us); spin_us=0 = old-style for A/B. Real VENC/VDEC IRQs assessed, not implemented (one handler per CPU, storm risk; design in kern/p031x/STATUS.md). 0315 for opus-jpeg: new additive ABI include/redwood_jpegdec.h, ioctl RWJD_JOB (nr 4): you pass the J04 words (addresses RWJD_SRC_PA 0xDA800000 / RWJD_IDX_PA 0xDB800000 / RWJD_OUT_PA 0xDB900000), kernel validates (allow-list, address regs inside the decoder claim, [I] scalars < 2^24), powers VEN+jpgdec bit12+larb7 11/12, writes in order (end with 0x240), polls 0x274, resets, copies dst_bytes of planes out; RWJD_PROBE = read-only E0/E1. RWJ_DECODE stays ENOTSUP; RWJ_INFO.reserved[0]=1 flags RWJD. Your 16 MiB-output concern is gone: decoder claim is separate from the encoder's 40 MiB. Not device tested.
